query_analysis.original_query: Outline an advanced process control system to stabilize the liquid discharge rate from a high-capacity separator during fluctuating feed conditions.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed design for an advanced process control system to maintain a stable liquid discharge rate from a high-capacity separator despite fluctuating feed conditions. This should include appropriate control strategies, instrumentation, and consideration of process dynamics.

selected_agents.role: Design and implementation of advanced control strategies
Provide insights on separator operation and dynamics
Develop process models and perform simulations

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative feedback between modeling and control strategy development
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated design approach with continuous input from all agents

clarification_questions: What specific fluctuations are occurring in the feed conditions (e.g., flow rate, composition, temperature)?
Are there existing control systems or instrumentation already in place?
What are the acceptable limits for the liquid discharge rate stability (e.g., allowable variance, response time)?
